goal.objective: Continuously advance canonical StegNutrition on the resident sovereign heartbeat without chat dependency, manual local-root selection, non-TV/TVC credential authority or hosted inference authority.
success_predicates: Exactly one already-local canonical StegNutrition tree is discovered automatically or one valid optional explicit override is accepted
Discovery performs no network lookup, remote source retrieval, hosted-provider selection or credential acquisition
Invalid explicit roots and ambiguous automatic roots fail closed
Canonical schema-v6 capability_inventory and tasks 020/021/022 are present
Runtime custody proves ROUTE_ADMITTED, credential_requirement NONE, replay binding retention and proof-tamper rejection
Scenario-provider preflight proves LOCAL_ONLY non-authorizing USDA/photo-portion/evidence binding and does not claim real semantic accuracy
scripts/run_full_validation_no_network.py emits stegnutrition.zero-network-validation.v1 and requires custody PASS, scenario PASS and complete-suite PASS
Worker v2 refuses unified execution when qualification promotion source, installer CLI, regression test, or task 022 record is absent

After unified validation PASS, scripts/run_real_data_qualification_no_network.py performs already-local real-data candidate qualification and emits stegnutrition.real-data-qualification-candidate.v1 without canonical source mutation
The resident v2 worker retains the real-data candidate proof under local_validation.real_data_qualification in the fenced continuation receipt
Canonical candidate promotion remains separate StegNutrition authority and requalifies current evidence before installation
The unified proof includes a non-authorizing release_projection derived from local canonical evidence and the local Git source commit
release_projection becomes READY_FOR_PROPAGATION only when all five task-017 predicates carry qualifying immutable evidence
The resident v2 worker retains the exact unified proof under local_validation.validation_proof in the fenced continuation receipt
Real semantic completion requires the canonical qualified artifact triplet
Real portion completion requires real photographed/weighed cases plus a governed passing portion-qualification receipt
Live TVC route, proof-bound ledger, release and propagation remain independently verified
failure_predicates: Any worker fetches StegNutrition source or requests credential authority
Manual local-root selection is required when one canonical local tree is discoverable
Invalid or ambiguous roots are silently accepted
A missing local repository, task 020, task 021, task 022, unified validator, candidate qualifier, hardened promotion surface or release projector is treated as success
Unified validation is represented as PASS without custody PASS, scenario PASS and full-suite PASS
Real-data candidate output is represented as canonical installation authority
Release readiness is represented as READY_FOR_PROPAGATION without all five immutable task-017 predicate evidence objects
Synthetic mechanics or benchmark fixtures are represented as real semantic/portion qualification
A second heartbeat, route authority, credential authority or model authority is created
Unavailable human/TV/TVC evidence is silently converted to COMPLETE

task.derivation_reason: This task binds canonical StegNutrition to the existing single resident heartbeat, retains unified zero-network validation, performs non-authorizing real-data candidate qualification after validation PASS, requires task-022 promotion surfaces before execution, and projects task-017 release readiness without source-mutation or publication authority.

completion.next_authorized_action: On the next lawful fenced resident claim, process:stegnutrition-machine-continuation-v2 auto-discovers the local tree, requires task 022 and its hardened promotion surfaces, performs preflights, executes unified validation, then executes real-data candidate qualification only on validation PASS and retains both proofs in the continuation receipt. block.block_reason: Resident fenced execution, real semantic/portion evidence, canonical artifact installation, and live TVC/live-pipeline evidence remain active constraints and are rechecked without chat-dependent authority.
block.escalation_condition: Any path attempts remote source retrieval, hosted model authority, second heartbeat/route authority, invalid/ambiguous root acceptance, invalid unified proof acceptance, candidate-to-canonical authority overreach, release-readiness overstatement, synthetic-to-real evidence overstatement, or unavailable-evidence completion
